from OpenSSL.crypto import load_certificate, FILETYPE_PEM, dump_certificate, FILETYPE_ASN1
import subprocess

# Load the certificate
pemData = open('tests/root_cert.pem', 'rb').read()
cert = load_certificate(FILETYPE_PEM, pemData)

# Dump it
dumped_pem = dump_certificate(FILETYPE_PEM, cert)
dumped_der = dump_certificate(FILETYPE_ASN1, cert)

print('Dumped PEM length:', len(dumped_pem))
print('Dumped DER length:', len(dumped_der))

# Try the openssl command
pem_file = '/tmp/test_cert.pem'
with open(pem_file, 'wb') as f:
    f.write(dumped_pem)

result = subprocess.run(['openssl', 'x509', '-in', pem_file, '-outform', 'DER'], 
                       capture_output=True)
print('OpenSSL stdout length:', len(result.stdout))
print('OpenSSL stderr:', result.stderr.decode())
print('OpenSSL returncode:', result.returncode)
"
